country.name: Uganda

default_in_force_rule.text: Not applied: every version is dated by ULII's own expression date, the day the amendment it incorporates took effect as Laws.Africa records it (for a consolidation, the date the revised edition is as at). No date is computed from a default rule.

sources.name: ULII, the Uganda Legal Information Institute (Judiciary of Uganda, on the Laws.Africa Peachjam platform)
sources.licence: CC BY-NC 4.0, crediting ULII as the source (https://ulii.org/en/terms-of-use/)
sources.notes: Point-in-time expressions of each act, /akn/ug/act/<...>/eng@<date>. ULII's document pages answer automated clients with a Cloudflare challenge, so each expression page is read from its latest Internet Archive capture (raw id_ form, under /akn/ or /en/akn/); the capture timestamps and sha256s are pinned in sources.json. Request count covers the Internet Archive and ULII's open listing pages.

sources.name: Internet Archive Wayback Machine
sources.licence: Archived copies of ULII pages; the content licence is ULII's
sources.notes: CDX API for discovery, then https://web.archive.org/web/<timestamp>id_/<original url> for the page bytes.

acts.title: Constitution of the Republic of Uganda, 1995
acts.label: Constitution of 1995

decisions: Phase 1 acts were chosen by what the archived source supports: every expression ULII lists for the Constitution (6) and the Penal Code Act (8) has an Internet Archive copy, so each version is read from its own dated expression.

The Revised Laws 2023 (the Law Reform Commission's revised edition, as at 31 December 2023) renumbered chapters and revised wording throughout; ULII publishes it as a consolidation, and its changes are committed as the publisher's, not credited to any Act, unless ULII's own note names the Act.
ai_use: Claude Code (Claude Opus 5.5, claude-opus-5-5) wrote the adapter and configuration and chose the acts. No model wrote, summarised or transformed legal text: parse.py is deterministic code.
